summary.text: Todd Novak is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 51 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 5, 2015.

paragraphs.text: Todd Novak is a lifelong resident of Iowa County and grew up on his family farm outside Cobb, according to Ballotpedia.
He has served as the government and associate editor of the Dodgeville Chronicle and was appointed to the Southwest Wisconsin Regional Planning Commission.
Novak was elected mayor of Dodgeville in 2012.
Novak was assigned to the Agriculture Committee, the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee and, as chair, the Local Government Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
